affected_subject.reason: Float128 library packedFloat decoding and arithmetic operations (add, sub, mul, div, sqrt, ln) are identified.

trigger_or_action.reason: Attacker flips L_MANTISSA_FLAG bit on a packedFloat input, producing a malformed value accepted by the library.

direct_effect.reason: Decode returns same mantissa/exponent despite different encoding, and calculations yield vastly different results due to wrong exponent adjustment.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected invariant that MANTISSA_MASK only applies to L_MANTISSA and flag-0 implies 128-bit mantissa is violated; sanity check on packedFloat can be bypassed while computation diverges.

summary: Report identifies Float128 packedFloat flag-flip trigger, affected decode/arithmetic functions, concrete divergent calculation effect, and the violated masking/flag invariant basis.
